extracted.name: Brownies Batch 8
extracted.description: Heath bars are delicious, I love brownies mixed together well, it's gotta be good. Super moist and definitely chocolate. #mycookbook
ingredient_lines: 1/3 cup extra dark cocoa powder unsweetened
1/3 cup extra dark cocoa powder unsweetened
instruction_lines: Preheat oven 350°Fahrenheit. Grease an 8x8 pan. Sprinkle with flour.
Chop the pecans, heath candy bars, and melt the butter.
Mix all the brownie mixture. Pour into the pan. Bake 25-30 minutes.
After the brownies are baked add frosting while it's warmed. Let cool and serve. I hope you enjoy!!!
